name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 27 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-05-09, at wavelengths from 1.67 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
